question_text: Do you have user access management procedures in place?
Are user access rights reviewed regularly (at least annually)?
Do you maintain an access control list for all systems?
Are access rights removed when employees change roles or leave?
Are user accounts created only after proper authorization?
Are user accounts deleted or disabled when employees leave?
Do you have a process for managing privileged access accounts?
Are privileged accounts reviewed and monitored regularly?
Do you require strong passwords for all user accounts?
Is multi-factor authentication implemented for sensitive systems?
Are failed login attempts logged and monitored?
Do you maintain audit logs for all system access?
Are audit logs protected from tampering or deletion?
Are audit logs reviewed regularly for security incidents?
Do you have a process for identifying and patching security vulnerabilities?
Are security patches applied within defined timeframes?
Do you maintain an inventory of all software and systems?
Do you perform background checks on new employees?
Are employment contracts signed before access is granted?
Do employment contracts include information security responsibilities?
Are employees required to sign confidentiality agreements?
Do you have documented procedures for financial data processing?
Are financial procedures reviewed and updated regularly?
Do you have a change management process for financial systems?
Are all changes to financial systems tested before implementation?
Do you have logical access controls to protect against unauthorized access?
Are access controls reviewed periodically?
Are access rights removed promptly when no longer needed?
Is user authentication required for all system access?
Are authentication credentials encrypted in transit and at rest?
Do you enforce password complexity requirements?
Is data encrypted when transmitted over public networks?
Do you use secure communication protocols (TLS/SSL)?
Do you have procedures for secure data disposal?
Are storage media securely wiped before disposal?
Do you have documented system operation procedures?
Are system operations monitored and logged?
Do you implement appropriate technical measures to ensure data security?
Do you have encryption in place for personal data?
Are regular security assessments conducted?
Do you have access controls to prevent unauthorized access to personal data?
Do you have a process for detecting personal data breaches?
Can you notify the supervisory authority within 72 hours of a breach?
Do you maintain records of all data breaches?
Do you conduct data protection impact assessments for high-risk processing?
Are DPIA results documented and reviewed?
Is personal data encrypted at rest?
Are backup systems secured and encrypted?
Do you have intrusion detection systems in place?
Do you have unique user identification for all system users?
Are access controls implemented to allow only authorized access?
Are access rights reviewed and updated regularly?
Is ePHI encrypted when transmitted electronically?
Do you have integrity controls to prevent unauthorized alteration of ePHI?
Are secure communication channels used for ePHI transmission?
Do you have audit controls to record access to ePHI?
Are audit logs reviewed regularly for unauthorized access?
Do you have a security management process in place?
Are security risks assessed and mitigated?
